relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 siRNA is able to inhibit expression of SASP-related genes and alleviate senescence in fibroblast-like synoviocytes

relationships.subject: RPL38
relationships.evidence_quote: Downregulating ribosomal protein L38 (RPL38) using siRNA, leading to the upregulation of suppressor of cytokine signaling 2 (SOCS2) expression and activation of the janus kinase (JAK)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) pathway, resulted in a reduction of chondrocyte apoptosis induced by interleukin 1β (IL-1β)

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: Silencing NLR family pyrin domain containing 1 (NLRP1) reduces the production of IL-1β induced by P2X4 purinoceptor (P2X4) in OA fibroblast-like synoviocytes

relationships.subject: RELA
relationships.evidence_quote: RELA proto-oncogene, NF-kB subunit (RELA) siRNA significantly inhibits the induction of IL-1β and TNF-α in the synovial fluid

key_findings: Review of siRNA therapy targets in OA chondrocytes, synoviocytes and osteoblasts, including METTL3, RELA, MMP13 and ADAMTS5 siRNAs.
